title: What's the Temperature Over There?
synopsis: At the end of the year there can be big temperature differences between the northern and southern parts of China.

fullText.simplified:
你们那儿几度？

    北京下雪了。中国更北边的哈尔滨已经零下23度了。但是中国南方有些地方的气温还是20度以上。北方和南方的温差非常大。
    这下住在南方的朋友可得意了，他们讽刺住在北方的朋友：“你在北方的寒夜里裹着貂，我在南方的艳阳天里露着腰。”很多人在网上晒自己所在城市的天气预报，再配上一句：短袖短裤，开着空调都嫌热。
    住在北方的朋友可不乐意了，他们说：“你们别高兴得太早，很快南方就要变天了。而且南方没有暖气，室内室外一个温度。过不了几天，估计就变成：你在南方的艳阳天里冻成狗，我在北方的寒夜里吃冰糕。”
    那么，你们那儿几度呢？
fullText.traditional:
你們那兒幾度？

    北京下雪了。中國更北邊的哈爾濱已經零下23度了。但是中國南方有些地方的氣溫還是20度以上。北方和南方的溫差非常大。
    這下住在南方的朋友可得意了，他們諷刺住在北方的朋友：“你在北方的寒夜裡裹著貂，我在南方的豔陽天裡露著腰。”很多人在網上曬自己所在城市的天氣預報，再配上一句：短袖短褲，開著空調都嫌熱。
    住在北方的朋友可不樂意了，他們說：“你們別高興得太早，很快南方就要變天了。而且南方沒有暖氣，室內室外一個溫度。過不了幾天，估計就變成：你在南方的豔陽天裡凍成狗，我在北方的寒夜裡吃冰糕。”
    那麼，你們那兒幾度呢？

raw.synopsis: At the end of the year there can be big temperature differences between the northern and southern parts of China.
sentence_translations: In Harbin, even further north in China, it is already 23 degrees below zero.
But in some areas in southern China the temperature is still above 20 degrees.
There is a great difference in temperature between the north and the south.
Our friends in the south felt proud of themselves and mocked our northern friends saying:
“While you spend the cold nights in the north wrapped in a blanket, ..”
“.. I'll be in the south exposing my skin in the blazing sun.”
A lot of people shared the weather forecast from their city online, and added:
“Wearing T-shirt and shorts, but it's still too hot even though the air conditioner is on.”
Our friends living in the north were not happy, and said:
“You shouldn't celebrate too early, soon the weather will change in the south.”
“And in the south you don't have heaters, so you have the same temperature indoors as outdoors.”
“Things will probably change in just a few days:”
“While you're in the south freezing like a dog, I'll spend the cold nights in the north eating ice cream.”
So what's the temperature where you live?
